world.title: China detains US nuclear expert on spying charge, his family says
world.summary: China has detained US seismologist Chen Youlin, 54, on espionage charges for nearly two years, according to his family. Chen was arrested in November 2024 while visiting family in Beijing. His family claims he has been wrongfully detained. Advocacy group Global Hostage Advocacy Coalition is involved in raising awareness about his situation and seeking his release.

world.title: Explained: Who really controls the Strait of Hormuz?
world.summary: The Strait of Hormuz, a crucial maritime corridor, has seen a significant decline in traffic due to escalating US-Israel-Iran tensions. Regional countries are exploring alternative trade routes amid concerns over security. The situation remains fluid, with ongoing developments following a 14-point deal signed on June 12, highlighting the complexities of control and access in this strategic waterway.

world.title: US reimposes naval blockade as Trump threatens to ramp up strikes on Iran: 'You better make a deal'
world.summary: US President Donald Trump reinstated a naval blockade on Iranian ports and threatened to target power plants and bridges if Iran does not resume negotiations. He urged Iran to "get to the table" while claiming US negotiators communicated with Tehran. This escalation follows overnight attacks attributed to Iran on Jordan, Kuwait, and Bahrain amid a deteriorating ceasefire agreement.

business.title: Tata Elxsi PAT declines 23% QoQ to ₹171 crore in Q1 FY27, revenue jumps 3%; check numbers
business.summary: Tata Elxsi reported a 23% quarter-on-quarter decline in profit after tax (PAT) to ₹171 crore for Q1 FY27, while revenue increased by 14.46% year-on-year to ₹1,021.11 crore. The company attributed its performance to growth in two key verticals, strong deal execution, and ongoing momentum in large strategic engagements, despite the decline in PAT compared to the previous quarter.

business.title: India's food-delivery billionaire eyes health tech, aerospace
business.summary: Deepinder Goyal, former CEO of a major food delivery company in India, is venturing into health technology and aerospace. He plans to launch a device called Temple, which measures the body’s metabolic state in real time, within six months. Additionally, Goyal has invested $20 million in LAT Aerospace, marking his first significant investment after leaving his previous role.

business.title: Fairfax to acquire IDBI Bank stake in $5.5 billion deal, biggest foreign investment in Indian bank
business.summary: Fairfax Holdings plans to acquire a significant stake in IDBI Bank for $5.5 billion, marking the largest foreign investment in an Indian bank. The deal involves collaboration with the government and LIC, expected to generate approximately 53,000 crore rupees from their combined stakes. This investment sets a new record for foreign capital influx into the Indian banking sector.

technology.title: iPhone 18 Pro: Apple's next smartphone to debut in September; check leaked price, design, battery, camera upgrades and more
technology.summary: Apple's iPhone 18 Pro is expected to debut in September, with leaked information suggesting various upgrades in design, battery, and camera features. Although Apple has not officially confirmed any specifications, early details indicate significant enhancements. The anticipation surrounding the new smartphone continues to grow as more information emerges from unofficial sources ahead of the anticipated launch.

technology.title: A forgotten immune organ in your chest may predict how long you live, with AI scans linking healthier thymuses to lower death, heart disease and cancer risks
technology.summary: Researchers have found that the thymus, an often-overlooked immune organ, may play a significant role in predicting lifespan. AI scans indicate that a healthier thymus is associated with reduced risks of death, heart disease, and cancer. This discovery challenges previous beliefs about the thymus's function after childhood, suggesting it may have lasting impacts on overall health.

technology.title: Samsung details the secrets of foldable screen Flex Titanium tech
technology.summary: Samsung has revealed its Flex Titanium technology, aimed at producing creaseless displays for upcoming foldable phones, including the Fold 8 and Flip 8. This innovation is expected to enhance the user experience by minimizing visible creases. The company is set to launch these devices soon, with anticipation surrounding their advanced display capabilities and overall design improvements.

sports.title: Road to South Africa up and running: Washington Sundar, Axar Patel deliver with bat and ball at Edgbaston
sports.summary: In the first ODI against England at Edgbaston, all-rounders Axar Patel and Washington Sundar played crucial roles, helping Team India achieve a 259-run target. The duo added an unbeaten 102 runs for the fifth wicket, showcasing their batting skills. Their performance contributed significantly to India's success in the match, marking a strong start in the series.

sports.title: FIFA World Cup 2026 stats: Yamal 6 - 0 Mbappé; Spain, Simón set WC record with 6; France's 0.3 worst in 60 years
sports.summary: In the 2026 FIFA World Cup semifinals, Spain defeated France 2-0, with goals from Mikel Oyarzabal and Pedro Porro, securing a place in the final. This match highlighted notable statistics, including Yamal's 6-0 performance against Mbappé and Spain's record-setting six goals. France recorded its worst performance in 60 years, with a goal-scoring average of 0.3.

sports.title: Shubman Gill's India ends England's 12-year home stronghold at Edgbaston with six-wicket win
sports.summary: India ended England's 12-year unbeaten streak in Men's ODIs at Edgbaston, securing a six-wicket victory in the first ODI. This win marks a significant achievement for India, who entered the series following a disappointing performance. The match concluded with India successfully chasing down the target, highlighting their strong performance against the historically dominant England team at home.

health.title: Trial of potential Ebola antiviral under way: WHO
health.summary: The World Health Organization has initiated the EBO-PEP trial to evaluate the antiviral obeldesivir's effectiveness as post-exposure prophylaxis for individuals who have come into contact with confirmed Bundibugyo Ebola cases. This clinical trial marks the first effort to test an antiviral drug's efficacy against the Ebola strain currently spreading in the Democratic Republic of Congo.

health.title: Over 700 dead in Ebola outbreak in DR Congo: First-ever human trial of Bundibugyo Ebola vaccine - when will it be ready?
health.summary: More than 700 people have died in the ongoing Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, marking the worst outbreak in the country's history. Health officials have reported over 1,900 cases linked to the Bundibugyo strain of the virus. A human trial for a Bundibugyo Ebola vaccine is underway, but its availability timeline remains uncertain.

science.title: Right Turn: These ancient creatures were righties before hands evolved
science.summary: Palaeontologists studied fossils of Spriggina, a thumb-sized, worm-like organism from the Ediacaran period, approximately 550 million years ago. Published in Scientific Reports, the research revealed that these ancient creatures exhibited a preference for right-sided movement, suggesting they were "righties" before the evolution of hands. This finding provides insights into the locomotion and behavior of early life forms.

science.title: A forgotten immune organ in your chest may predict how long you live, with AI scans linking healthier thymuses to lower death, heart disease and cancer risks
science.summary: Researchers have found that the thymus, an often-overlooked immune organ, may play a significant role in predicting lifespan. AI scans indicate that a healthier thymus correlates with reduced risks of death, heart disease, and cancer. This discovery challenges previous beliefs about the thymus's function after childhood, suggesting it may have lasting impacts on overall health and longevity.

science.title: 67-million-year-old T. rex fossil 'Gus' sold for record $50.1 million at Sotheby's auction, becomes world's most expensive dinosaur fossil
science.summary: A 67-million-year-old Tyrannosaurus rex fossil, nicknamed "Gus," was sold for a record $50.1 million at a Sotheby's auction in New York. This sale marks Gus as the most expensive dinosaur fossil ever sold. The auction highlights the increasing interest and value in paleontological artifacts, reflecting both scientific significance and collector demand in the market.

entertainment.title: Ahn Bo Hyun And Jung Eun Chae Join Hands To Eradicate Crime In New Drama "Flex X Cop 2" Poster
entertainment.summary: SBS has unveiled new posters for its upcoming Friday-Saturday drama "Flex x Cop 2." Ahn Bo Hyun returns as Jin Yi Soo, a third-generation chaebol heir who leverages his wealth and connections in crime-fighting. Jung Eun Chae also stars, joining him in the effort to combat crime. The drama promises action and intrigue in its storyline.

entertainment.title: Pregnant Samantha Ruth Prabhu says she has been waiting for this moment: ‘Always wanted to be a mother’
entertainment.summary: Actor Samantha Ruth Prabhu announced she is expecting her first child with filmmaker Raj Nidimoru. The couple, married in December 2025, shared their pregnancy news in June. In a recent interview, Prabhu expressed her excitement about becoming a mother, stating she has always wanted to experience motherhood. The couple looks forward to this new chapter in their lives.

entertainment.title: Christopher Nolan's The Odyssey is courting controversy. Here are 4 reasons why
entertainment.summary: Christopher Nolan's upcoming film, The Odyssey, has sparked controversy regarding its casting, dialogue, filming, and design choices. The backlash has intensified ahead of its release on July 17, 2026. Known for creating successful films, Nolan's previous work, Oppenheimer, also generated significant debate. The controversies surrounding The Odyssey have emerged even before the historical epic reaches theaters.
